collection.title: Mazda 121 1996 to 2000 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: All of the following wiper blades will fit a Mazda 121 1996 to 2000 model which requires a 19" wiper blade on the drivers side and a 19" for the passengers side. This model uses the Standard Hook arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm.
